$comment: THE DETAIL-PAGE REGISTRY (N03, decisions M-D6/M-D7). One row per name@version; rows are KEPT when a new version ships, so an old chit still finds its page. minor = a compatible body change, major = a header or action change. The api refuses an unknown name at mint (PAGE_UNKNOWN); the app opens an unknown name or version on the base page with a note. MASTER: chitbridge-web/public/app/pages.json. chitbridge-api/data/pages.json is a byte copy (tests/page-name.test.cjs checks it).

pages.name: chit.base.detail
pages.says: the chit page in CRM (crm.html#/chit/<id>): the chit sheet mounted full-page (app/chit-sheet.js CBSheet.mount, CRM2); the workshop's Task pane (app.html design 1, design 2 from app/cap-chit2.js) still opens it there until M53 is designed

pages.name: showcase.designer.gallery
pages.says: gallery-first: photo grid, enquiry face (designer, cards); sections under one data contract (S2)

pages.name: showcase.food.menu
pages.says: menu: categories and rows, order face (food); sections under one data contract (S2)

pages.name: showcase.paint.specs
pages.says: spec wall: rows with unit/size chips, quote face (paint, hardware); sections under one data contract (S2)

pages.name: showcase.services.booking
pages.says: booking: service cards, booking face (services); sections under one data contract (S2)
